mkdir -p ui-driver/Host ui-driver/UITests && cat > ui-driver/project.yml <<'EOF'
name: UIDriver
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.example
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "16.0"
targets:
  Host:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - Host
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.UIDriver
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
      CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
  UITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - UITests
    dependencies:
      - target: Host
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.UIDriver.UITests
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
      CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
EOF
cat > ui-driver/Host/App.swift <<'EOF'
import SwiftUI
@main struct HostApp: App {
    var body: some Scene { WindowGroup { Text("UI test host") } }
}
EOF
cat > ui-driver/UITests/UITests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class UITests: XCTestCase {
    func testNavigateAndOpenAttachmentMenu() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)
        print("ELEMENT TREE BEFORE\n\(app.debugDescription)")
        let room = app.staticTexts["Weekend Plans"]
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Weekend Plans room not found")
        room.tap()
        sleep(2)
        print("ELEMENT TREE ROOM\n\(app.debugDescription)")
    }
}
EOF
xcodegen generate --spec ui-driver/project.yml
